structure.note: One class of common stock. The proxy lists two 5% holders, Vanguard Capital Management (7.4%) and BlackRock (6.0%); all current directors and executive officers as a group held less than 1%.

notes: Fiscal year ended July 31, 2026 (matches data.js fy 'Jul 2026'). Financial figures are from the FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0001327567-26-000023, filed September 10, 2026), checked against SEC XBRL; FY2026 amounts are reported in whole millions. Ownership is from the proxy published after that year (DEF 14A, accession 0001308179-26-000432), as of September 18, 2026. In fiscal 2026 the company acquired Chronosphere (January 2026) and CyberArk Software (February 11, 2026; $18,862 million of the consideration was paid in stock), which raised shares outstanding to about 818 million. LEADER: Nikesh Arora (Chair and CEO) beneficially owned 2,158,729 shares, less than 1% (marked * in the proxy), so pctEconomic is null. The total includes 1,056,783 PSU shares vesting within 60 days and excludes 2,958,459 vested and deferred RSU/PSU shares; on October 12, 2026 the Aurora Trust pledged up to 500,000 shares under a prepaid variable forward contract while keeping beneficial ownership. HOLDERS: the proxy gives the 13G filing dates (Vanguard Capital Management April 30, 2026; BlackRock 13G/A January 26, 2024, stale) but not the dates the holdings refer to, so asOf is null. BUYBACKS exclude $126 million of taxes paid on net share settlement of equity awards. STOCK COMP: the note total ($1,815 million) is used; the cash-flow add-back is $1,774 million. GEOGRAPHY: the 'Total Americas' subtotal is omitted to avoid double counting.

owners.notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the Q1 FY2027 10-Q cover count at November 11, 2026 (rounded to 821 million on the cover), the same count used in the marketcap lens.

marketcap.notes: One class of common stock, listed on Nasdaq as PANW. The 10-Q for the quarter ended October 31, 2026 (filed November 2026) is the latest count; its cover rounds to 821 million. The FY2026 10-K cover gives 818 million at August 31, 2026, and the proxy 818,443,112 at September 18, 2026. Shares rose from about 662 million after CyberArk's acquisition in February 2026 was paid largely in stock.

pay.notes: Employees: year-end head count stated in the FY2026 10-K risk factors (the human capital section gives no number). Payroll: the FY2026 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the proxy's CEO pay ratio median is used; it is for fiscal 2026, identified from the population of about 21,173 employees at May 1, 2026, excluding about 3,864 CyberArk employees acquired on February 11, 2026. It includes the grant-date fair value of equity awards, so it is far above cash pay.
